title: Vasily the Bear and Fly
statementMd:
One beautiful day Vasily the bear painted $2*m*$ circles of the same radius $*R*$ on a coordinate plane. Circles with numbers from $1$ to $*m*$ had centers at points $(2*R* - *R*, 0)$, $(4*R* - *R*, 0)$, $...$, $(2*Rm* - *R*, 0)$, respectively. Circles with numbers from $*m* + 1$ to $2*m*$ had centers at points $(2*R* - *R*, 2*R*)$, $(4*R* - *R*, 2*R*)$, $...$, $(2*Rm* - *R*, 2*R*)$, respectively.

Naturally, the bear painted the circles for a simple experiment with a fly. The experiment continued for $*m*^{2}$ days. Each day of the experiment got its own unique number from $0$ to $*m*^{2} - 1$, inclusive.

On the day number $*i*$ the following things happened:

1. The fly arrived at the coordinate plane at the center of the circle with number ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3df97a98dd984c03bd53b2f4c4c7288bd321ddc.png) (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d85d9be5f5d8cb39c28e7277ba0b39c3ccd4f0e.png) is the result of dividing number $*x*$ by number $*y*$, rounded down to an integer).
2. The fly went along the coordinate plane to the center of the circle number ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ce2bb6c4a4ddae405ec27cce4e3cfeaee3958192.png) (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f58f159973d4609d919286c1821e69cd34d81118.png) is the remainder after dividing number $*x*$ by number $*y*$). The bear noticed that the fly went from the center of circle $*v*$ to the center of circle $*u*$ along the shortest path with all points lying on the border or inside at least one of the $2*m*$ circles. After the fly reached the center of circle $*u*$, it flew away in an unknown direction.

Help Vasily, count the average distance the fly went along the coordinate plane during each of these $*m*^{2}$ days.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*m*, *R*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$, $1 ≤ *R* ≤ 10$).

## Output

In a single line print a single real number — the answer to the problem. The answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

## Note

statementZhMd:
某个晴朗的日子，熊 Vasily 在坐标平面上绘制了 $2*m*$ 个半径均为 $*R*$ 的圆。编号从 $1$ 到 $*m*$ 的圆，其圆心分别位于点 $(2*R* - *R*, 0)$、$(4*R* - *R*, 0)$、$...$、$(2*Rm* - *R*, 0)$。编号从 $*m* + 1$ 到 $2*m*$ 的圆，其圆心分别位于点 $(2*R* - *R*, 2*R*)$、$(4*R* - *R*, 2*R*)$、$...$、$(2*Rm* - *R*, 2*R*)$。

当然，熊绘制这些圆是为了和一只苍蝇进行一个简单的实验。实验持续了 $*m*^{2}$ 天。实验中的每一天都有一个从 $0$ 到 $*m*^{2} - 1$（包含两端）的唯一编号。

在编号为 $*i*$ 的这一天，发生了以下事情：

1. 苍蝇到达坐标平面，并出现在编号为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3df97a98dd984c03bd53b2f4c4c7288bd321ddc.png) 的圆的圆心处（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d85d9be5f5d8cb39c28e7277ba0b39c3ccd4f0e.png) 表示将数 $*x*$ 除以数 $*y*$ 后向下取整得到的整数）。
2. 苍蝇沿坐标平面飞到编号为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ce2bb6c4a4ddae405ec27cce4e3cfeaee3958192.png) 的圆的圆心处（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f58f159973d4609d919286c1821e69cd34d81118.png) 表示数 $*x*$ 除以数 $*y*$ 后的余数）。熊注意到，苍蝇从圆 $*v*$ 的圆心到圆 $*u*$ 的圆心所经过的是一条最短路径，并且路径上的每个点都位于这 $2*m*$ 个圆中的至少一个圆的边界上或内部。苍蝇到达圆 $*u*$ 的圆心后，便向未知方向飞走。

请帮助 Vasily 计算在这 $*m*^{2}$ 天中，苍蝇每天沿坐标平面飞行的平均距离。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*m*, *R*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$，$1 ≤ *R* ≤ 10$）。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个实数，即题目的答案。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则视为正确。
